Author: MrReeh
Name: Milk Meter
Description: Drives Customize+ chest scale from your choice of source: a Food Buff timer, Mana percentage, or an in-combat Job Actions mode built around GCD usage, tracked job abilities, jumping, and damage taken. Displayed as an animated baby-bottle HUD gauge with configurable fill zones, a pause toggle, and an optional high-scale threshold effect (vignette, glow, heartbeat sound). Fully configurable in-game via a settings window. Requires Customize+. Local only: nobody else sees it.
Punchline: Turns your combat actions into a chest-scaling mini-game.
